summary.one_liner: Flowise is an open-source tool for building AI agents and LLM workflows through a visual interface, installable via npm or Docker. Note that the README says the project has been archived.
keywords: run ai agents on my server
summary.what_it_does: Flowise provides a visual interface for building AI agents and LLM workflows. It can be installed globally with npm and started with npx, or run via Docker Compose or a locally built Docker image on port 3000. The repository is a pnpm monorepo with a Node.js server for API logic, a React UI, a components package for third-party node integrations, and auto-generated Swagger API docs. Developers can clone the repo, build all modules, and run a dev mode with hot reloading. The README lists configuration through environment variables and points to hosting options on major clouds and several PaaS providers, plus a hosted Flowise Cloud offering. The README states that the project has been archived and links to a "Future of Flowise" notice.
use_cases: build an AI agent without writing code
self-host an AI agent builder on my own infrastructure
deploy a chatbot backend with an API
how_to_run: Open the app in your browser (default port 3000)
Alternatively, with Docker: copy docker/.env.example to docker/.env and run 'docker compose up -d' from the docker folder
notable: Visual, node-based builder for AI agents and LLM workflows
Installable with a single npm command or run via Docker Compose
Monorepo split into server, ui, components and api-documentation modules
Auto-generated Swagger API documentation from Express routes
Hosting guides for AWS, Azure, GCP, Railway, Render, HuggingFace Spaces and others
caveats: The README states the project has been archived and refers readers to a 'Future of Flowise' notice
Building all modules may require increasing the Node.js heap size (NODE_OPTIONS) to avoid out-of-memory errors
Flowise Cloud is a hosted paid-service option mentioned only by name, with no pricing details in the README
